answer: Keeping 259 aliases alive as a result means 259 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the knoll quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the willow log reveals the live set and the thread audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 661 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
